title: Eliminate wait-induced supervisor model reactivation
objective: Correct the Durable Supervisor execution and wakeup contract so that a running child cannot cause supervisor inference merely because a terminal wrapper yields, times out, or returns nonterminal control; preserve explicit human interaction and permit exactly a terminal or intervention event to reactivate automatic supervision.
scope: Runner wait ownership and terminal event publication
Codex host-terminal wrapper yield and time-window boundary
event-driven wake registration and eligible wake reasons
supervisor behavior after nonterminal wait return
activation telemetry and deterministic trajectory audit
focused state-machine, wakeup, telemetry, and operator-control tests

may: inspect repository source, tests, docs, durable runtime records, and read-only Codex trajectory artifacts relevant to the observed defect
inspect the event-driven-agent-wakeup and agent-trajectory-profiler sibling repositories read-only for contract compatibility
implement the smallest local wait/wakeup adapter that fails closed on nonterminal wrapper returns
add durable activation events classified as terminal-event, human, or wait-induced automatic
derive activation counts from observable Codex trajectory evidence without inventing provider measurements
preserve deterministic zero-model status and watch for human use during child execution
add focused deterministic regression coverage and run repository verification
may_not: modify .opsle runtime authority, historical events, decisions, evidence, requirements, objective history, policy, supervisor identity, tasks, attempts, or claims
modify sibling repositories or depend on uncommitted sibling changes
redefine polling as provider-status probes only
claim zero provider/model turns without provider or trajectory evidence
treat a healthy heartbeat as an eligible model wake event
weaken Runner timeout/stall, claims/fencing, Gearbox, Context Firewall, Acceptance, pause, or recovery behavior
invoke Claude, enable review, deploy, merge, push, create a PR, install server-wide, or initialize another repository

relevant_context: The prior child interval began at 2026-08-31T20:52:24.491Z and completed at 2026-08-31T21:03:34.571Z for task-fix-derived-next-action-invariant-attempt-001.

The local Runner correctly awaited the OS child close event and emitted heartbeats, but the outer Codex exec wrapper returned a nonterminal session after one second and subsequent write_stdin waits returned every 30 seconds.

Every nonterminal wrapper return was followed by observable supervisor reasoning in the same Codex turn; status --json was invoked during the running-child interval at 20:54:51, 20:58:20, and 21:01:51 UTC.

The current CHILD_COMPLETION event nevertheless recorded model_turns_used_for_polling as zero because that field is hard-coded and observes only the local Runner, not host-level supervisor activations.
A model turn that decides to wait again, inspect heartbeat, run status, or reconcile a still-running child is a wait-induced activation even without a provider-status API probe.

Eligible automatic wake classes are durable terminal/intervention events; explicit human interaction is separately eligible; timeout/yield/nonterminal wrapper return and healthy heartbeat are ineligible.
The event-driven-agent-wakeup sibling prototype registers a wait and applies idempotent events but has no Codex host adapter and initializes zero model turns without observing them.

A controlled 35-second host-wrapper test proved that an enclosing tool cell can mechanically consume the terminal wrapper's 30-second nonterminal return and deliver only terminal completion to the model when its outer wait window exceeds the bounded task timeout.
The correction must retain a deterministic read-only status/watch path for humans and leave provider policy Codex enabled, Claude disabled, review off.
expected_deliverable: A narrow, documented wait/wakeup and telemetry correction that prevents nonterminal wrapper returns from being treated as reasons for supervisor reasoning, records or deterministically derives all observable supervisor activations inside child intervals, and provides a live-proof-ready path whose terminal timeout is explicit and bounded.
expected_evidence: root-cause explanation tied to exact prior trajectory timestamps and wrapper returns
deterministic wait-registration state exists before child launch/dormancy
nonterminal yield, wrapper timeout, and heartbeat events cannot transition the wait to model-ready
terminal completion/failure/timeout/stall/intervention and explicit human interaction have distinct semantics
status and bounded watch remain read-only and provider-free
telemetry exposes total automatic activations inside each child interval plus terminal-event, human, and wait-induced counts
legacy hard-coded polling zero cannot hide observable wait-induced activations
acceptance_criteria: the bug is defined as any wait-induced supervisor inference, not only explicit child-provider polling
automatic model readiness is impossible for nonterminal wrapper yield/timeout/return or healthy heartbeat
waiting remains in deterministic OS/event code until a durable terminal/intervention event or explicit human interaction
an actual task timeout/stall is represented as a durable terminal or intervention-required event
human-initiated interaction during a child interval is allowed and classified separately
telemetry distinguishes terminal-event, human, and wait-induced automatic activations and reports unknown where evidence is absent
prior immutable history and stale-next-action correction remain intact
focused and full deterministic verification pass
prohibited_actions: editing prior trajectory, event, decision, requirement, or evidence records
papering over the defect by renaming polling or narrowing its definition
using a model sleep/check loop in implementation or tests
claiming the repository can prevent host inference without an enforceable adapter or fail-closed contract
broad refactoring unrelated to Runner, wakeup, activation telemetry, tests, or accurate docs
release, merge, deployment, server-wide installation, or cross-repository initialization
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
model polling and wait-induced automatic reasoning prohibited
